facts.text: The giant, which captured Brother Dirk on his way to the Barrow to eat him in a stew, still lives in its huge stone cottage in a forest clearing on the party's route north and endangers travellers passing near it; it is slow and was easily outrun.
facts.classification: {"harm_origin":"external","negative_outcome_clarity_justification":"Dirk says the giant captured him and meant to eat him; capture and being eaten is a specific harm.","negative_outcome_clarity":"high","outcome_severity_justification":"Being captured and eaten means death.","outcome_severity":"high","evidentiary_strength_justification":"The party saw the giant and its captive and fled it; Dirk's testimony confirms it captures travellers.","evidentiary_strength":"high","evidence_of_progression_justification":"It has already captured a traveller heading the same way and still lives on the route, but nothing shows it pursuing the party now; it gave up the chase.","evidence_of_progression":"medium","preventability_justification":"The party knows where the cottage is, can avoid the clearing, and outran the slow giant easily.","preventability":"high"}
